note: Drone reader sets (2026-11-10, step P0 of docs/2026-11-10-neumor-plan-whole-architecture.md; design by Luis Jake Gabriel III): per population the attention heads, as [layer, head] with global head numbers, that read a tentacle window. `default` serves every tentacle; `tentacles` may give a lens (by name, nmsubs::lens::NAMES) its own set. Read by nmengn::kvstore::drone_set; the tentacle pass encodes and keeps chunks through the highest layer any set reads. Checked by `neuromorph-nano check designs`. The qwen3-0.6b default is the 16 heads the E2 runbook rule chose on the CX1 development half (runs/2026-11-10-neumor-note-e2-head-probe.md), equal to nmengn::kvstore::DRONE_HEADS_QWEN3_0_6B, which stays the stated fallback and what the locked E3.3 and G1 runners read.
note_version_2: 2026-11-10 (tentacle core A8, docs/2026-11-10-neumor-design-tentacle-core-v1.md section 2.3 and section 5): per population `read_mode` (`exact`: the question posed after the window, the only mode built; `scan`: keys-only fast scan, not built), `source` (the record the set was selected on) and `verification` (the set the tentacle core's re-read uses: `default` or its own list of [layer, head]). Per-tentacle sets stay allowed under `tentacles` (each a list of [layer, head]); none is written until a lens has enough questions to validate on a held-out fold, so every tentacle reads with the default set. The default set is unchanged from version 1.
